status: EMBODIMENT ADAPTER EXTENSION. The unused top of the recorded thumb-yaw range now drives the thumb over the rod top.
why: see g1_piston_press_geometry.json: thumb yaw is the only press mechanism, and the policy could not command it (ceiling 0.46 rad < 0.9 rad grip floor).
mapping: yaw_cmd = max(rec_yaw, gate*0.9) + (0.40/0.12) * max(rec_yaw - 0.30, 0), clamped to 1.3. rec_yaw 0.42 -> 1.30.
backward_compatibility: recorded yaw <= 0.30 leaves every output bit-identical (tested over the demonstrated range -0.10..0.25 and 0.30). The demonstrations' maximum is 0.25 (= q99). Existing checkpoints are affected only if they emit thumb yaw > 0.30, which lies above the data they were trained on; their certified numbers remain valid for the retargeter version they were scored under and are re-scored where it matters.
policy_range: 0.42 rad is normalised 1.97 (inside the +/-2.2 squash range, off the asymptote); 0.46 is the ceiling and also maps to 1.3 after the clamp.
